hooks.name: Spec completion review
hooks.description: Asks the agent to reconcile the finished task with its spec before moving on.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Before continuing: (1) identify which requirement numbers in .kiro/specs/vigil-core/requirements.md or .kiro/specs/proof-of-focus/requirements.md this task satisfies; (2) confirm its checkboxes in the matching tasks.md are accurate; (3) check the design doc still describes the implementation; (4) run the relevant gates if any were skipped. Report one short paragraph, then continue.
